# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}

Delete a release from a repository by tag name

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (write access to releases required) · **ID:** `ep-345`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| tag | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Release not found or is a tag-only record
- **422** — Tag name is protected

| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | release_service.DeleteReleaseByID | service | Set IsTag=true on release; Update release in DB; Load attachments; Delete attachments from storage; Send notification |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Tag-only records (IsTag=true) are not treated as releases and return 404 | validation | release.IsTag == true |
| Protected tag names cannot be deleted | authorization | Tag name matches a protected tag pattern and user is not allowed |
| Deleting a release (without delTag) marks it as tag-only rather than removing the DB record | business_logic | delTag == false |
| Release attachments are deleted from storage when release is deleted | business_logic | Release has attachments |

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | medium | Release deletion involves DB update + attachment deletion from storage. If storage delete fails, attachment records are already deleted but files remain orphaned |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ DB update (IsTag=true) + attachment record deletion + storage file deletion are not fully atomic

**Cascading failure risk:** Storage failure leaves orphaned files but release is still marked as deleted

**Graceful degradation:** Partial failure: release marked as tag, but attachment files may remain in storage
